ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels cover approximately 65% of the visible surface, concentrated in the central region; high-intensity (white/grey) pixels cover 35%, located primarily on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad black central pigmentation extending to the trailing edge. White/grey mottling with salt-and-pepper texture on both distal lobes. A distinctive yellowish-tan pigmentation patch is located on the upper portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge, characterized by numerous small-amplitude peaks and valleys. Pronounced jaggedness is visible on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edge follows a convex curve transitioning into tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of light-colored, circular protrusions (barnacles) on the right distal tip. Minor white circular focal points scattered on the black pigmentation of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark diagonal linear mark is visible on the high-intensity section of the left lobe. Multiple smaller horizontal scratches are present on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of live barnacles on both distal tips. A unique yellowish discoloration is visible on the left lobe's ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific combination of a sharp median notch and the asymmetrical tan-colored pigment patch on the left lobe serves as a unique identifier.
